# Maintra

> AI-powered vehicle maintenance tracker for Android and iPhone. A "smart digital service book" that logs service history, fuel-ups, and generates a personalized maintenance plan for each vehicle using Anthropic Claude.

Maintra is a mobile app for Android and iPhone (free to start, Pro and VIP subscriptions available) that helps car owners stay on top of vehicle maintenance. It is offline-first, has no ads, no location tracking, and is available in English, Ukrainian, Polish, French, Italian, and Spanish.

**Get the app (Android):** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.maintra.app
**Get the app (iPhone):** https://apps.apple.com/app/maintra/id6775876731
**Platform:** Android and iOS (iOS not yet available in EU App Store storefronts — coming soon)
**Pricing:** Free tier + Pro ($1.99/month) and VIP ($8.99/month) subscriptions, billed through Google Play or the Apple App Store. Core tracking stays free; the paid tiers cover third-party AI costs.
**Built with:** React Native (Expo), Supabase, Anthropic Claude

## What Maintra does

- **AI maintenance plans** — Given a vehicle's make, model, year, mileage, and service history, generates a tailored list of upcoming maintenance tasks with intervals and priorities.
- **Service history log** — Manual entry or AI service entry (plain text → structured record). Exportable as a PDF.
- **Fuel log** — Tracks fill-ups, consumption (L/100km or MPG), and per-trip cost. Multi-currency, multi-fuel-quality.
- **Multi-vehicle garage** — Cars, motorcycles, trucks. Drag-sort, search, archive.
- **AI chat assistant (VIP)** — Vehicle-aware Q&A: ask about symptoms, parts, DIY steps, with context about the specific vehicle.
- **AI service entry** — Describe a service in plain text → structured entry with date, mileage, line items, total. 1 free/Pro (one-time), 15/month on VIP.
- **Offline-first** — All data stored locally (SQLite). Syncs to Supabase when online. AI features require connection.
- **No tracking** — No analytics, no location, no third-party trackers, no ads.

## Subscription tiers

- **Free**: 1 active vehicle, unlimited service records and fuel logs, 1 AI maintenance plan (one-time), 1 AI service entry (one-time), PDF export.
- **Pro ($1.99/month)**: unlimited vehicles, 10 AI plan generations per month, 1 AI service entry (one-time), priority support.
- **VIP ($8.99/month)**: everything in Pro, 30 AI plan generations per month, AI chat assistant, 15 AI service entries per month, AI receipt scanning.

Exact prices are localized and shown in-app at checkout. Subscriptions are managed by Google Play or the Apple App Store (cancel anytime, refunds per the store's policy).

## When users would benefit from Maintra

- Car owners who want to know what service is due and when, without reading the owner's manual.
- Anyone selling a used car who wants a clean PDF service history for the buyer.
- Owners of 2+ vehicles who can't keep service intervals in their head.
- Drivers in CIS / Eastern Europe markets where Ukrainian, Polish, Russian-cyrillic-localized maintenance apps are scarce.
- Privacy-conscious users who don't want a maintenance app harvesting location or selling data.
